implemented_routines.name: emulator_key_wait
implemented_routines.scope: Host-owned cursor bitmaps and blink state; begin, mandatory per-key tick, no-key timer/counter iteration, raw pair transfer and hidden-pixel restoration. Canonical visible fonts6/7/10, all65536 raw host pairs, clipped/wrapped coordinates, callback events and finite counter wrapping.

api.state: fx_key_wait owns two20-byte bitmaps, framebuffer/destination addresses, blink phase/gate/countdown/period, remaining-transition and idle counters, active and ready flags
api.begin: fx_key_wait_begin initializes native phase0, period/countdown1 and1195 transitions; writes8E00=1
api.tick: fx_key_wait_tick advances blink and timer129A before checking8E01|8E02; increments8224 only when idle
api.finish: fx_key_wait_finish clears8E00, reads/stores the raw pair in bus order and restores hidden pixels;8E01/8E02 remain unchanged unless the supplied output destination aliases them
api.begin_host: fx_key_wait_begin_host initializes the same wait with host-owned output only
api.finish_host: fx_key_wait_finish_host returns the current raw pair in host state, with no synthetic RAM destination stores; wait-flag clear and hidden bitmap restore are unchanged

gaps: Visible fonts outside6/7/10, suppressed heights above10, and height growth into native uncaptured local bytes return explicit unsupported status
Destination aliases to original CPU-call-stack memory are outside the native parity domain
Outer1DB34 bridge/token/reset-request routing is implemented in fx_key_controller; called menu/input/evaluator controllers remain separate
Physical-time scheduling, interrupts and complete reset-to-keypress device I/O remain pending

verification.oracle: Original ROM1D802 in independent SimU8; checkpoints1D8A4,1D8B6,1D8D2,1D8D4 and return
verification.comparison: Complete persistent RAM/MMIO and callback events; original CPU-call-stack8D00..8DED excluded. Defined native cursor fields are inspected independently, never exported to C memory.
verification.limitation: Routine-level emulator lifecycle with passive physical peripherals; not a firmware-completion claim
